english.note: Use this for two things happening at the same time, especially when they happen in different places.

examples.english: Meanwhile, Mum was cooking at home while I was in a meeting at the office.
examples.traditional: 同一時間，阿媽喺屋企煮緊飯，我就喺公司開緊會。
